nodes.label: Extension.svg — TYPO3 Extension Icon
nodes.description: TYPO3 extension icon for the sitepackage. SVG depicting two flame-like curved paths in orange (#FF8700), forming the TYPO3 logo mark. Dimensions 83x84px, viewBox anchored at (43,42). Serves as the backend icon identifying the schmid/sitepackage extension in the TYPO3 Extension Manager.

nodes.label: TYPO3 Brand Orange (#FF8700)
nodes.description: The fill color #FF8700 used in the extension icon, matching the official TYPO3 brand orange color.

nodes.label: schmid/sitepackage TYPO3 Extension
nodes.description: The main TYPO3 sitepackage extension for kfv-freising.de, providing page templates, content blocks, and the Tailwind CSS design system.
